# googleworkspace_group (Data Source)

Looks up a single Google Workspace group by its email address.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "googleworkspace_group" "board" {
  email = "board@spokanemountaineers.org"
}

output "board_group_id" {
  value = data.googleworkspace_group.board.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The group's email address (primary or an alias).

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the group.
- `id` (String) Immutable group ID.
- `name` (String) Display name of the group.
